explanation.tr:
will-future gelecekle ilgili şu durumlarda kullanılır:
• Tahminler: It will rain tomorrow. I think she will win.
• Anlık kararlar: "The phone is ringing." – "I'll answer it."
• Sözler ve teklifler: I'll help you. I will call you later.
• Yapı: will + yalın fiil (tüm öznelerde aynı)
• Kısaltma: I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll
• Tahminle sık kullanılanlar: I think, probably, maybe, I'm sure.
explanation.tk:
will-future geljek bilen bagly şu ýagdaýlarda ulanylýar:
• Çaklamalar: It will rain tomorrow. I think she will win.
• Şol pursatdaky kararlar: "The phone is ringing." – "I'll answer it."
• Wadalar we teklipler: I'll help you. I will call you later.
• Gurluşy: will + esasy işlik (ähli eýelerde birmeňzeş)
• Gysgaltma: I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll
• Çaklama bilen köp ulanylýanlar: I think, probably, maybe, I'm sure.
explanation.ru:
will-future используется для будущего в таких случаях:
• Прогнозы: It will rain tomorrow. I think she will win.
• Спонтанные решения: "The phone is ringing." – "I'll answer it."
• Обещания и предложения: I'll help you. I will call you later.
• Схема: will + глагол (одинаково для всех лиц)
• Сокращения: I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll
• С прогнозами часто: I think, probably, maybe, I'm sure.

topic: Tenses – will-future: Negations in the will-future
title: will-future: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
will-future olumsuz: won't (will not) + yalın fiil.
• I won't be late. She won't come. It won't rain.
• Reddetme: The door won't open. (Kapı açılmıyor.) My son won't eat vegetables.
• Söz: I won't forget your birthday.
• Tahmin: I don't think he will come. (Daha doğal: I think he won't come yerine.)
• won't tüm öznelerle aynıdır.
explanation.tk:
will-future ýokluk: won't (will not) + esasy işlik.
• I won't be late. She won't come. It won't rain.
• Ret etmek: The door won't open. (Gapy açylanok.) My son won't eat vegetables.
• Wada: I won't forget your birthday.
• Çaklama: I don't think he will come. (I think he won't come-dan has tebigy.)
• won't ähli eýeler bilen birmeňzeş.
explanation.ru:
Отрицание в will-future: won't (will not) + глагол.
• I won't be late. She won't come. It won't rain.
• Отказ: The door won't open. (Дверь не открывается.) My son won't eat vegetables.
• Обещание: I won't forget your birthday.
• Прогноз: I don't think he will come. (Естественнее, чем I think he won't come.)
• won't одинаково для всех лиц.

topic: Tenses – will-future: Questions and short answers in the will-future
title: will-future: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
will-future soru: Will + özne + yalın fiil?
• Will you come to my party? Will it rain?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
• Rica/istek: Will you help me, please? (Bana yardım eder misin?)
• Teklif/öneri için Shall I/we kullanılır: Shall I open the window? Shall we go?
Kısa cevapta kısaltma yapılmaz: Yes, I will. (✓) – Yes, I'll. (✗)
explanation.tk:
will-future sorag: Will + eýe + esasy işlik?
• Will you come to my party? Will it rain?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
• Haýyş: Will you help me, please? (Maňa kömek ederňmi?)
• Teklip üçin Shall I/we ulanylýar: Shall I open the window? Shall we go?
Gysga jogapda gysgaltma ulanylmaýar: Yes, I will. (✓) – Yes, I'll. (✗)
explanation.ru:
Вопрос в will-future: Will + подлежащее + глагол?
• Will you come to my party? Will it rain?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
• Просьба: Will you help me, please? (Поможешь мне?)
• Для предложения используют Shall I/we: Shall I open the window? Shall we go?
В кратком ответе нельзя сокращать: Yes, I will. (✓) – Yes, I'll. (✗)

topic: Tenses – will-future: Questions in the will-future
title: will-future: Wh-Questions

explanation.tr:
Soru kelimeli will-future soruları:
• Soru kelimesi + will + özne + yalın fiil?
  What will you do tomorrow? Where will they stay? When will the bus come?
• Özne sorusu: Who will help me? What will happen?
• How long will ...? / How much will it cost?
• Kısa olarak: What'll you do? (konuşma dilinde)
explanation.tk:
Sorag sözli will-future soraglary:
• Sorag sözi + will + eýe + esasy işlik?
  What will you do tomorrow? Where will they stay? When will the bus come?
• Eýe soragy: Who will help me? What will happen?
• How long will ...? / How much will it cost?
• Gysgaça: What'll you do? (gürleşik dilinde)
explanation.ru:
Специальные вопросы в will-future:
• Вопросительное слово + will + подлежащее + глагол?
  What will you do tomorrow? Where will they stay? When will the bus come?
• Вопрос к подлежащему: Who will help me? What will happen?
• How long will ...? / How much will it cost?
• Разговорное: What'll you do?

topic: Tenses – will-future: Sentences and questions in the will-future
title: will-future: Statements and Questions Practice

explanation.tr:
will-future'da cümle, olumsuz ve soru biçimlerini birlikte çalış:
• Olumlu: You will love this book.
• Olumsuz: You won't love this book.
• Soru: Will you love this book?
• Wh-soru: Which book will you read?
Hatırla: will'den sonra fiil hep yalın hâldedir ve 'to' almaz. will her özneyle aynıdır.
explanation.tk:
will-future-de tassyklaýjy, ýokluk we sorag görnüşlerini bilelikde türgenleş:
• Tassyklaýjy: You will love this book.
• Ýokluk: You won't love this book.
• Sorag: Will you love this book?
• Wh-sorag: Which book will you read?
Ýatda sakla: will-den soň işlik hemişe esasy görnüşde we 'to' almaýar. will ähli eýeler bilen birmeňzeş.
explanation.ru:
Тренируй утверждение, отрицание и вопрос в will-future вместе:
• Утверждение: You will love this book.
• Отрицание: You won't love this book.
• Вопрос: Will you love this book?
• Специальный: Which book will you read?
Помни: после will глагол всегда в начальной форме и без 'to'. will одинаков для всех лиц.
